scene: The holographic map hums, unfolding glowing secret routes across the city.
picture: A glowing, detailed pixel-art holographic projection fills the frame in a first-person view. The map glows with neon cyan, yellow, and magenta contour lines. The player's brown hands hover near the edge. On the left pulses a cyan harbour icon, at the centre shines a yellow subway symbol, and on the right blinks a red pyramid beacon.
shown: a pulsing cyan light marking the sea docks on the left side of the map
a bright yellow subway icon hovering in the map's centre
a blinking red pyramid marker on the right side of the floating projection

variants.scene: Neon gridlines shimmer beneath your hands, displaying every district of the city.
The luminous map buzzes softly as glowing transit paths trace through the dark.
Electric city routes spark to life across the glowing blue holographic screen.
